name: sermon-slide-builder
description: Run a private Pastor Assistant OS that builds, reviews, fixes, and improves faithful sermon PowerPoints through approved local rules.

interface.shortDescription: Build sermon decks and learn approved corrections.
interface.longDescription: Pastor Assistant Agent OS gives ChatGPT and Codex a private local operating loop for pastor work: load approved preferences, create editable 16:9, 32:9, or exact-template sermon PowerPoints, review the result independently, fix mistakes, and remember only generalized corrections the pastor explicitly approves.
defaultPrompt: Start my Pastor Assistant OS and build this week's sermon PowerPoint.
Review this sermon deck, fix what is wrong, and ask before remembering a new rule.
Remember this approved correction for my future sermon work.
